description: This file defines the class EmbeddedURLForYoutube within the namespace OrangeHRM\Buzz\Dto\BuzzVideoURL. The class extends AbstractBuzzVideoURL and provides functionality to extract embedded URLs from YouTube links, including validation and transformation of various URL formats to a standard embedded URL format.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForYoutube
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and extracting embedded YouTube URLs from input URLs, including validation and regex-based URL format handling.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded YouTube URL if the input URL matches known YouTube URL patterns; throws an exception if the URL is invalid or cannot be processed.
